proof_body:
by
  intro m n
  have hm : (m : ℝ) + 1 ≠ 0 := by positivity
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    rw [Finset.prod_range_succ']
    simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_Icc_succ_top (by omega), ih]
    have e1 : ∏ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), ((n : ℝ) + (i : ℝ)) = (∏ i ∈ Finset.range m, (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + (i : ℝ))) * (n : ℝ) := by
      rw [Finset.prod_range_succ']
      congr 1
      · apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
        intro i _
        push_cast
        ring
      · simp
    rw [e1, Finset.prod_range_succ]
    generalize (∏ i ∈ Finset.range m, (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + (i : ℝ))) = Q
    push_cast
    field_simp
    ring
target_source: ∀ m n : ℕ, ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, ∏ i ∈ Finset.range m, ((k : ℝ) + (i : ℝ)) = (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), ((n : ℝ) + (i : ℝ))) / ((m : ℝ) + 1)
